payload.rebuttal: fixed: Every existing names_file assertion happened to return the same answer whether the check was startswith(path) or the weaker `path in witness`, because in each case the leftover slice still started with an alphanumeric character. Added `assert not names_file("xy:ab", "ab")`: here `ab` is a substring of `xy:ab` but not its prefix, so the correct function returns False while the substring-only mutation returns True, which the witness now catches.
